verdict.rationale: Viam has a dedicated first-party doc page explicitly for AI agents operating machines via shell/SDK/API, covering resource discovery, health/status checks, motion planning through a declarative API, and JSON-in/JSON-out CLI access — directly matching the story of an agent commanding a robot end-to-end. Scoped credentials are supported via the fleet API's permissions/authorization management (org/location/machine level) and API keys implied in CLI auth flows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of an actual AI agent completing an end-to-end task, and more granular detail on credential scoping (e.g., per-capability API key scopes) beyond general 'manage permissions and authorization.'
